from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssets(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data for a single company regarding Total Assets."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    total_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of Total Assets as reported")
    total_assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported value (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The date or period the Total Assets figure corresponds to")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt containing the Total Assets figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyAssets]
